title: SpiderTamperPayload
description: Payload for event_type=spider.tamper, schema_version major=1. High-priority signal (Step 5: 'Tamper + health high-priority') that something tried to interfere with MirageSpider's own observation — e.g. an attacker inside the sandbox attempting to stop or blind the agent. Routed to the immutable audit stream (subjects.py: audit.spider.tamper), not the short-retention telemetry stream, because tamper attempts are inherently security-relevant regardless of case outcome.
